test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Tap A can fill an empty tank in 8 hours if no other tap is open, and tap B can empty the same tank, when filled, in 12 hours, when no other tap is open. Find the time taken to fill the same tank, when empty, if both the taps are opened together.
solution:
Given:

Tap A filled an empty tank = 8 hours

Tap B empty a filled tank = 12 hours

Calculation:

Tap A filled a tank in 1 hour = (1/8)

Tap B empty a tank in 1 hour = (1/12)

Time required to filled a tank = (1/8) – (1/12)

= 1/24

= 24 hours

∴ Time required to fill a tank is 24 hours.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
